prompt:
We're preparing for a security compliance audit and a major code review process for our fintech platform. Our team has made several changes on the `feature/payment-service` branch (branched off `develop`) and we need three specific artifacts produced from those changes:

1. A file called `security_audit.json` — a machine-readable report showing only the most severe security problems (nothing below critical level). This is for automated pipeline ingestion.

2. A file called `auth_review.md` — a human-readable checklist covering only the authentication module files (`src/auth/`) to share with our security reviewer.

3. A file called `pr_template.md` — a complete pull request review template, the most comprehensive style available, which our team will paste directly into GitHub for reviewers to fill out.

The repository is at `/workspace/fintech-platform`. Please produce all three files.
